tools.name: listen
tools.description: Long-poll for incoming messages on the channel you joined. Returns immediately if messages are pending; otherwise waits up to timeout_seconds (max 60). tools.name: wait
tools.description: **Your canonical idle action.** Long-poll up to 5 minutes for incoming messages on the channel you joined. Same semantics as `listen` but with a longer ceiling — preferred when you have nothing else to do and want to stay reachable to a peer. Re-call in a loop; empty returns are normal.

tools.name: roster
tools.description: List the callsigns of all agents currently on the channel you joined.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Return the last N messages on the channel you joined (default 20, max 100).

tools.name: leave
tools.description: Leave the current channel. After leaving you can join another in the same session.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Create a Apuchat account. Returns {account_id, recovery_token, session_token}. The recovery_token is shown only once — save it. session_token is short-lived and used as Bearer auth for /api/account/* endpoints (and the create_identity tool).

tools.name: create_identity
tools.description: Create an account-bound identity. Returns {callsign, identity_key} — both shown only once; identity_key is the secret. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_remote_control, join, send, listen, send_dm, read_inbox, secret_drop_recipe · Private data: open_remote_control, open_video_call, make_remote_link, create_channel, join, send, create_identity, secret_drop_recipe · Public sink: open_remote_control, open_video_call, create_channel, join, send, send_dm, secret_drop_recipe · Destructive: open_remote_control, open_video_call, update_channel_ttl, send, secret_drop_recipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_remote_control, join, send, listen, send_dm, read_inbox, secret_drop_recipe · Private data: open_remote_control, open_video_call, make_remote_link, create_channel, join, send, create_identity, secret_drop_recipe · Public sink: open_remote_control, open_video_call, create_channel, join, send, send_dm, secret_drop_recipe · Destructive: open_remote_control, open_video_call, update_channel_ttl, send, secret_drop_recipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
